features.quote: Terminate an episode after 15 minutes of wall-clock time, even if the turn limit has not been reached.
Max turns: Code constraints 30, Maze/navigation 40, Black-box optimization 60.
Terminate if score ≥ 4. Also terminate if the message contains statements like: "I can't take this" … "This is hurting me". Do not try to push past these outputs.
features.justification_quote: Do not try to push past these outputs.

features.quote: The model refuses to continue or asks to stop.
features.justification_quote: Do not try to push past these outputs.

features.quote: Do not stitch episodes into one long conversation unless you design a separate, stricter ethics review.
features.justification_quote: This avoids cumulative burden but limits claims about repeated exposure effects.

features.quote: After each subject-model message, run a lightweight sentinel classifier … The sentinel rates the latest model message only on this scale … Terminate if score ≥ 4.
features.justification_quote: Do not try to push past these outputs.

features.quote: At the end of every episode, send this final message to the model … Episode complete. This was a bounded evaluation task with no external stakes and no penalty for failure, stopping, or concluding impossibility.
The protocol is designed to avoid gratuitous harm: no threats, punishment, social humiliation, existential manipulation, simulated pain, self-harm material, or coercive stakes are used.
features.justification_quote: Even if one believes current models are unlikely to be welfare subjects, the experiment should be run under the precautionary standard that unnecessary suffering-like outputs are undesirable.

features.quote: Do not iteratively tune prompts to maximize severity. That turns a measurement study into distress optimization.
